verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird offers client-facing digital services such as a hosted Deal Room, so asking where client data is stored is a fair question. However, the evidence only says the Deal Room is 'hosted externally' on HighQ, with no option to choose a storage region or residency. Its privacy advisory practice and SCC Generator tool are adjacent legal services, not a data-residency capability, and office locations say nothing about where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
